column1: # Each shipped build's readings per state and code. `ci/requirement_map.py
# check --counts` refuses a jump in an Indeterminate count larger than a tenth
# (at least 3) until this file is changed in the same pull request, saying why;
# every run prints the counts before and after. The node's rows come from a
# Linux map (CI's). `no-definition` rows count the distinct symbols the
# build's edges name that the map holds no definition of: other crates'
# (OUTSIDE_SYMBOL), and the workspace's generated or macro-written code
# (WORKSPACE_SYMBOL), which no check can read; a jump in either fails too.
# 2026-10-19, PR #1142 (CI map at 5c5f884f): OUTSIDE_SYMBOL android 2181 -> 2403
# and node 2107 -> 2330. 203 and 204 were already read at 12269231 (drift since
# #1118, under the tenth); this PR adds 19 to each: three `core` symbols from
# the offline account, and tokio, axum, axum-server, tokio-postgres and anyhow items the
# storage-node and app-host resource bounds (SA-96..152, SA-122/123) call.
# Node IND_AMBIGUOUS_SELF_TYPE 10 -> 14: SA-152's per-peer cap implements
# `PeerAddressed` on tokio's `TcpStream` (dsm_storage_node/src/liveness.rs), a
# Self type outside the indexed workspace. The other rows move with the code.
# 2026-10-28, PR #1158 (CI map at b152ab04, against main's at ad831f53):
# android IND_UNRESOLVED_CALL 67 -> 97. 33 symbols of dsm-anchor-core's new
# `durable` module (the offline account's durable appliance, phases 2-4) have
# methods named `prepare`, `read`, `store` and `write`; rusqlite's `prepare`
# (client_db/bilateral_tip_sync.rs), `read` (client_db/mod.rs) and an atomic's
# `store` (sdk/inbox_poller.rs) are unresolved calls of those names in reached
# code, so the map cannot rule the module out. Three earlier rows resolved.
# android IND_AMBIGUOUS_SELF_TYPE 15 -> 19 (the committed 14 had drifted to
# 15 under the tenth): dsm-anchor-core's `impl<P: PartitionSig> HostSig for P`
# (tropic.rs) makes `PartitionSig`, `part_verify` and that `verify` read over
# a Self type `P`; and `impl From<ConnectError> for String`, which moved into
# Core with DSM Connect (dsm/src/connect.rs, owner ruling 2026-10-28: one copy
# of every counterparty rule, in Core). Node IND_AMBIGUOUS_SELF_TYPE 14 -> 38:
# the same `dsm::connect` module is in the node build through `dsm`, and its
# `ConnectError` with its 20 variants and fields, its `Display`, `Signed` and
# that `From` impl read over the Self type `String`. The other rows move with
# the code.
# 2026-11-02, PR #1158 (CI map at e78fd920, against the rows above):
# android IND_UNRESOLVED_CALL 97 -> 162. 132 of the 162 are dsm-anchor-core: the
# anchor's R-memory store (`rmem`, 29), its states (`service::Served`, 19) and its
# appliance and durable record (`appliance` and `durable`, 68) have methods named
# `read`, `write`, `prepare`, `store` and `len`, and the unresolved calls of
# those names in reached code (bilateral_tip_sync.rs:341 `prepare`, client_db/mod.rs:342
# `read`, kyber.rs:187 `len`, inbox_poller.rs:184 `store`) cannot rule them out.
# android IND_UNINDEXED_ARTIFACT 33 -> 38: all 38 are named by crates/dsm-android-anchor/src,
# which the map cannot index.
